rows.description: I lend my friend my colours when she forgot hers and expect nothing. Small generosity builds trust. If she never returns them, I can politely ask. Kindness with boundaries is healthy.

rows.description: One classmate is nice only when she needs something from me. I feel used. Wise: say no without explaining too much and notice who is kind without a reason. Friends do not only take.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: coercion, generosity, loyalty

rows.description: On my first day nobody talks to me at lunch. It is a hard feeling and normal. I try small steps: smile, ask to join a game, sit near someone friendly. Friends take weeks, not hours.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, grief, mockery, resentment, trust

rows.description: I miss my old friends and my old city so much. Missing them shows love, not weakness. I call and write to them and also open a small space for new ones. Living only in the past keeps me stuck.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, loneliness, mockery, resentment, trust

rows.description: I am angry at my parents for moving me and say I hate this place. The choice was not mine, so my anger makes sense. I say what I miss. They can listen without fixing everything.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, grief, loneliness, mockery, trust

rows.description: My new teacher pairs me with a helpful buddy and I feel a bit safe. I accept help, ask questions and learn the school's ways. Being new is not being lesser.

rows.description: Some kids mimic my accent or language on my first week. It stings and I feel ashamed of who I am. Wise: stay calm, do not change myself for them, tell a teacher if it continues, and find kinder peers.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: curiosity, grief, loneliness, resentment, trust

rows.description: In my class a new kid arrives and I am curious and shy. I can say hello, show him around and invite him to play. One kind act can change his first week.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: grief, loneliness, mockery, resentment, trust

rows.description: In a new school I want to be someone cooler than I was. A fresh start can help me try new things. But pretending to be someone else wears me out. I aim to be my best self, not a fake.

rows.description: My old friend replies less after I moved, and it hurts. Distance changes friendships, and it is nobody's fault. I can stay in touch on holidays and accept that we may drift while staying fond.
